# Bazimoon

Bazimoon is a free online game hub in English and Persian. It offers daily logic puzzles, word games, classic games, party games, Mafia with voice chat, and games for couples. Games run in a web browser without a download.

## Main pages

- English games: https://bazimoon.com/en/
- بازی‌های فارسی: https://bazimoon.com/fa/
- XML sitemap: https://bazimoon.com/sitemap.xml

## Persian game pages

- پازل زیپ: https://bazimoon.com/fa/zip/
- ملکه‌ها: https://bazimoon.com/fa/queens/
- سودوکو: https://bazimoon.com/fa/sudoku/
- کلمه روز: https://bazimoon.com/fa/daily-word/
- اسم فامیل: https://bazimoon.com/fa/esm-famil/
- مافیا آنلاین: https://bazimoon.com/fa/mafia/
- بازی جاسوس: https://bazimoon.com/fa/spy/
- کوییز زوج‌ها: https://bazimoon.com/fa/couple-quiz/
- دوز: https://bazimoon.com/fa/tic-tac-toe/
- بازی حافظه: https://bazimoon.com/fa/memory/
- بازی مار: https://bazimoon.com/fa/snake/

## English game pages

- Daily puzzles: https://bazimoon.com/en/sudoku/ and https://bazimoon.com/en/zip/
- Daily Word: https://bazimoon.com/en/daily-word/
- Mafia: https://bazimoon.com/en/mafia/
- Esm-Famil: https://bazimoon.com/en/esm-famil/

## Language support

Every major page has English and Persian versions. Persian pages use right-to-left layout and Persian game instructions. Equivalent language versions are connected with reciprocal hreflang links.
